description: Home Affairs global visa processing times: how many days it took to finalise 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% of applications, per visa subclass and stream, with the date Home Affairs published the figures. Use this tool first for One U visa processing time questions. Pass visaSubclass for one visa (with Home Affairs notes), add stream for that stream only (PhD and research master's Student visa questions: visaSubclass "500", stream "postgraduate_research"), or omit visaSubclass to list every subclass. The figures are global percentiles for recently finalised applications. State this scope if the user mentions nationality or lodgement location. Do not present these percentiles as a country-specific result or a grant timeline. zh-CN / zh-TW return Chinese visa and stream names with the official English ones in nameEn / streamEn; Home Affairs notes stay in English. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

stream.description: Optional stream within visaSubclass, as the streamId the results return: for subclass 500 "postgraduate_research" (PhD and research master's), "higher_education" (bachelor's and coursework master's), "vocational_education_training", "independent_elicos", "schools", "non_award", "foreign_affairs_defence"; for 482 e.g. "core_skills". The official English stream name is also accepted. Needs visaSubclass; a stream the subclass does not have returns the valid values.

visaSubclass.description: Visa subclass number, e.g. "500", "189", "482", "485", "820", "600", "491". "491F" is accepted and treated as 491.

name: get_visa_processing_times
title: Get Australian visa processing times
